description: "Autobiography and Selected Essays" by Thomas Henry Huxley is a collection of personal reflections and essays written during the late 19th century. The work provides insight into Huxley’s life experiences, scientific philosophy, and educational beliefs, as he explores themes of natural knowledge, the importance of education, and his engagements with various scientific ideas.
